text: {"type_map":{},"constraints":[{"id":"R1","category":"protocol","alternatives":["(df['PROTOCOL'] == 6) | ((df['TCP_FLAGS'] == 0) & (df['CLIENT_TCP_FLAGS'] == 0) & (df['SERVER_TCP_FLAGS'] == 0))"],"features":["PROTOCOL","TCP_FLAGS","CLIENT_TCP_FLAGS","SERVER_TCP_FLAGS"],"rationale":"TCP flag features are specific to TCP, so they are zero for non-TCP flows."},{"id":"R2","category":"protocol","alternatives":["(df['PROTOCOL'] == 6) | ((df['TCP_WIN_MAX_IN'] == 0) & (df['TCP_WIN_MAX_OUT'] == 0))"],"features":["PROTOCOL","TCP_WIN_MAX_IN","TCP_WIN_MAX_OUT"],"rationale":"TCP window features are specific to TCP, so they are zero for non-TCP flows."},{"id":"R3","category":"protocol","alternatives":["(df['PROTOCOL'] == 6) | ((df['RETRANSMITTED_IN_BYTES'] == 0) & (df['RETRANSMITTED_IN_PKTS'] == 0) & (df['RETRANSMITTED_OUT_BYTES'] == 0) & (df['RETRANSMITTED_OUT_PKTS'] == 0))"],"features":["PROTOCOL","RETRANSMITTED_IN_BYTES","RETRANSMITTED_IN_PKTS","RETRANSMITTED_OUT_BYTES","RETRANSMITTED_OUT_PKTS"],"rationale":"Retransmission features count TCP retransmissions and are zero for non-TCP flows."},{"id":"R4","category":"protocol","alternatives":["(df['PROTOCOL'] == 1) | ((df['ICMP_TYPE'] == 0) & (df['ICMP_IPV4_TYPE'] == 0))"],"features":["PROTOCOL","ICMP_TYPE","ICMP_IPV4_TYPE"],"rationale":"ICMP type features are specific to IPv4 ICMP flows and are zero for other IP protocols."}]}
